demos.name: Coding Agents LAB
demos.description: Inspection inside Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot and Antigravity through each agent's own hook interface, answered in that agent's native allow, deny or ask, as a simulation of the 2026-11-02 Ping release claims. Mock tables, or a Live local engine that runs a real hook script. Every product claim is UNVERIFIED on our tenant.
demos.notes: Host-run: ./scripts/run.sh (port 7150). Docker: HOST_PORT=7150 docker compose up --build -d (published on 127.0.0.1 only). Mock and Live are both loopback-only with zero outbound calls; the lab never writes an agent configuration anywhere. No catalog id yet (placeholder D0 in the content pack).
